logos.ubicacion: No existe logo gráfico ni carpeta public/. La marca es tipográfica: título 'HOME' en verde #23654E peso 700 (.panel-header h1.brand, app.css:54) y <title>Field Shift</title>

legal: Decision support only. It does not replace local experience: check with your agronomist and neighboring farmers. (ui.tsx:48, en todos los paneles)
Not a decision: it orders options with model data and general crop traits that are not yet verified locally. Check with your agronomist. (CropSuggestions.tsx:129)
Scores order the options; they are not a chance of success. Rotation, price, yield and risk numbers come from models trained on Weld County, CO data. Check with your agronomist. (Crops.tsx:134)
The sliders repaint the heat-wave and rain layers. They show how the model reacts to a change; they are not a climate projection. (Home.tsx:63)
Water balance and water reserves are not available: there is no model or data for them yet, so nothing is shown rather than made-up numbers. (Layers.tsx:111)
Atribución del mapa base: VITE_BASEMAP_ATTRIBUTION (ej. 'Imagery © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics', .env.example); licencia [POR VERIFICAR]
Observed data from NASA POWER, not forecasts: the models only apply to Weld County. (GlobalLayer.tsx:133)
otros_datos_clave: Zona de los modelos: Weld County, Colorado (U.S.); centro por defecto del mapa [-104.71, 40.42], zoom 11 (data/index.ts:19-20)
Escenario por defecto: rainPct 0, tempDelta 0; rangos lluvia -50..+50 %, temperatura -2..+4 °C (paso 0.5)
Presets de prioridades (Crops.tsx:9-14): Balanced 50/50/50/50; Protect the soil water40 soil100 erosion90 income20; Maximize income 30/20/20/100; Save water 100/40/40/30
Prioridades por defecto de FieldForm: [40, 80, 25, 90] = water, soil, erosion, income (FieldForm.tsx:13)
Umbrales de puntuación: Good >= 70, Fair 40-69, Poor < 40 (CropSuggestions.tsx:15-16)
Alertas: Erosion points, Droughts, Stress points; sin dato: 'N/A' / 'Not loaded on the server yet' (data/index.ts:395-411)
Notas fijas de Risks.tsx:62-64: umbrales provisionales; 2 puntos meteorológicos ~50 km; 2,499 píxeles de estrés en Weld County; erosión = potencial relativo
Calidad de modelos medida sobre el 20 % más reciente de los datos (DataHub.tsx:159)

Textos de LiveForecast (LiveForecast.tsx:33-38): c05b Heat-wave risk / next 7 days; c08a Chance of rain tomorrow / tomorrow; c08b Expected monthly rain / next 6 months; c04 Root-zone soil moisture / next 4 weeks
Etiquetas de fuente: Live / Saved batch / Not available (LiveForecast.tsx:8)

Colores de datos que NO son decoración y deben preservarse: rampas de capas globales (GlobalLayer.tsx:16-18), parcela #E8A531 60 % con borde blanco punteado (FieldMap.tsx:98-102), gradientes de slider rain/heat (app.css:269-270), colores de series (#4464E8 precios; #34B3F1 y #292D30 estadísticas), niveles low/medium/high (app.css:274-277)

Textos i18n: TODO src/data/i18n.ts (diccionarios EXACT, SOURCE, CROP_NAMES, MODEL_NAMES, TEXT, TEMPLATES) y las traducciones en LiveForecast.tsx:10-45 y risk.tsx:19-63 deben preservarse literalmente; no se tocan en el rediseño

Nombres de cultivo (i18n.ts:57-61): frijol Bean, maiz Maize, maiz_grano Grain maize, avena Oats, sorgo Sorghum, trigo Wheat, trigo_invierno Winter wheat, cebada Barley, chile Chili pepper, papa Potato, alfalfa Alfalfa, veza Vetch (green manure), soya Soybean, girasol Sunflower, remolacha Sugar beet, barbecho Fallow, mijo Millet, triticale Triticale, otro Other, otro_heno Other hay
Opciones de formulario: meses Jan..Dec; riego Rainfed/Gravity/Sprinkler/Drip; suelo Clay/Sandy/Loam/Use satellite data; equipo Seed drill/Row crop planter/No-till drill
Variables de entorno: VITE_API_URL (default /graphql), VITE_BASEMAP_TILES_URL, VITE_BASEMAP_ATTRIBUTION, BACKEND_URL (vite proxy)
